in_marathi.name: Gargee
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gargee हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Gargee is the goddess of knowledge and wisdom. She is the embodiment of knowledge and learning. She is often depicted as holding a lamp or book, symbolizing enlightenment.
